about: Named functions (the `functions` selector's items) from this repo's history and 9 hand cases. The silent cases are the defects reviews found: bones r2 C4 (skin.ts chainWeights, ownWeights and bind before 8d08de4e5), looks review C6 (card.ts verseLayout at 56d263b4c), pass6 R6-server-4 (montageFolder and publishSet at fbeefe131), p6-judged review-1 m1 (changedLines before ea5c248cb), p6-studio-edit M1 (BeatEdits.hold before 82530e3e7), and the hymnal compile before c7bdafb50; plus five found by reading (listNotes' 20-note cap, versesFor's swallowed lookup, mergedCatalog's skipped source, expandParsed's dropped ranges, content list's unreadable folder). The said cases are mostly the same functions after their fixes (near pairs), and functions whose fallback is logged, typed or returned (egw-search surroundingParagraphs, hymnal settings call, test-budget judge, redfirst skippedOf). A fallback stated only in a doc comment, with nothing at run time, counts as silent. Counts: 19 silent (14 repo, 5 hand), 27 said (23 repo, 4 hand), 46 cases.
